short_description: Havells 9 W B22 LED bulb, 849 lm cool day light 6500 K, 15,000 h life, 4 kV surge protection, works from 140-270 V. BEE 1 Star.
long_description:
## What it is

The Havells LED Plus 9 W B22 CDL Lamp V7 (model LHLDDDBNL5R009) is a self-ballasted LED bulb with a round polycarbonate body, an opal polycarbonate diffuser and a B22 bayonet cap — the ordinary pin-type holder used in almost every Indian house. It draws 9 W and puts out 849 lumens of 6500 K cool day light, which works out to 94.44 lm/W and earns it a BEE 1 Star label. Havells makes it in India and sells it under its Adore+ LED lamp identity.

## What it's for

General indoor lighting: living rooms and bedrooms first, and equally at home in a corporate office, a shop, a restaurant or a hotel corridor. At 849 lm it replaces a roughly 57 W incandescent bulb one-for-one in the same holder, so it is the straightforward swap when an old bulb fails or when a new flat is being lamped up.

## Key specifications

It runs on 220-240 V AC at 50 Hz and draws 0.05 A, with a power factor of at least 0.90 and total harmonic distortion below 33 %. The point that matters on an unstable feeder is the withstand range: the lamp keeps working from 140 V to 270 V, starts from 100 V, carries 4 kV of in-built surge protection and 3.75 kV of isolation. The colour rendering index is 80 or better, start-up is under two seconds, and there is no flicker visible at rated voltage and no UV or IR in the beam. Rated life is 15,000 hours to the F50 L70 code with 7,500 switching cycles. The lamp measures 60 mm across and 113 mm tall, weighs 48 g net, and is rated IP20 for ambient temperatures of 0-35 °C.

## Application and installation notes

Push the cap into the B22 holder and twist a quarter turn; any orientation is fine. It is not dimmable, so keep it off dimmer and regulator circuits. Do not fit it inside a fully enclosed luminaire — the IP20 rating and the 0-35 °C ambient limit both assume the lamp can shed its heat into open air. Being polycarbonate rather than glass, it survives a knock that would shatter a filament bulb.

## What's in the box

One lamp in a printed carton, net contents 1 N, carton 65 × 60 × 120 mm. Trade packing is a master box of 316 × 316 × 250 mm weighing 3.14 kg. The lamp carries a one-year Havells warranty.
